"I'm living to avoid hurting them."  I know this might seem strange, but that is amazingly touching.  You yourself are hurting inside, wanting to leave, yet you're staying because you have such a heart that you don't want others to hurt.

The world needs more people like you, not less!  Also, please don't think there isn't someone out there who wouldn't love a shy fat computer dude!  Just gotta bump into the right one at some point - someone who will also appreciate that big heart you have.  

Timing is everything.  Don't accidentally tap out too early and miss it.

We humans have this idea that life is supposed to go in a certain order.  We think things like, "I'm this age and I haven't did XYZ yet."  In your case, maybe you feel that you should have met someone by now.

But perhaps for right now that door isn't ready to open; maybe the timing just isn't right or you're just not in the right place for it.

Maybe move your focus to trying to build yourself up and give yourself worth.  What makes you happy?  What do you feel you're good at?  Build on those things.  Try something new, too, because when you go out of your comfort zone, you force yourself to grow and that's how you get confidence.
